name: gfmx
description: GFMX X.509 certificate template fingerprint (KEY:SPAN:MAKER:AUDIENCE:NAMES). Certificates generated from the same tool or template share it even when names, serials, dates and keys change.

pattern.description: GFMX pattern with wildcarded segments, e.g. a1371c39:*:65fa07e6::6bc11ca7

key.description: KEY segment: issuance, key algorithm and size, signature algorithm

span.description: SPAN segment: validity length and kind

maker.description: MAKER segment: encoding traces of the generating tool

audience.description: AUDIENCE segment: EKU, Key Usage, Basic Constraints, policies

names.description: NAMES segment: issuer and subject attribute types

raw.description: Pre-hash strings, one per segment, for review and near-match search

x509-fingerprint-sha256.description: SHA-256 of a certificate that carries this fingerprint

tool.description: Tool, builder or framework the template is attributed to (e.g. msfvenom APK signer)

certificate-count.description: Distinct certificates observed with this fingerprint
